As a first-time sole trader with simple income, the **Self Assessment Simple** package at £119 per tax year would likely be the best fit for you. This package is designed for straightforward tax situations and should cover your needs effectively.

If you have any specific questions about what’s included in the package or how to register for Self Assessment, feel free to ask! You can also find more details on the Self Assessment packages [here](https://www.taxsimba.co.uk/self-assessment).

As a landlord needing Making Tax Digital (MTD), the lowest suitable Simbian plan is **Simbian Comply**, which costs **£29.99 per month** (VAT included). This plan includes the necessary digital bookkeeping services and quarterly MTD updates, along with year-end Self Assessment preparation and submission, provided you meet the documented responsibilities.
